12	
13	## Intent
14	
15	**Problem:** Meus Registros has no export entry point; the backend already exposes job creation (`POST /export/summary`) and polling (`GET /export/:jobId/status`), but `lib/features/export/` is three empty scaffold folders.
16	
17	**Approach:** Build the `export` feature slice end to end: a download icon opens a period picker, confirming creates the job, and a bottom sheet polls status, swapping content in place across Pendente/Processando/Concluído/Erro/Período vazio, reusing existing sheet, button, and `Failure` infrastructure.
18	
19	## Boundaries & Constraints
20	
21	**Always:**
22	- Call `export-summary-create`/`export-status-get` by `x-cerne-function` name, `jobId` as trailing path segment — never the literal REST paths.
23	- Poll only, never stream. Reuse the existing `Failure.exportEmptyPeriod` for "Período vazio" — never add a new `Failure` subtype (AD-3).
24	- Model progress as its own sealed domain entity (mirror `BookmarkState`) — never force `status`+`narrativeStatus` into `Resource<T>` (AD-12).
25	- Sheet content replaces in place per stage change; sheet never closes/reopens mid-job; every state keeps "Fechar" (UX-DR15).
26	- Add `export-summary-create` to `RetryInterceptor.neverRetriedFunctions` (non-idempotent POST, no idempotency key — a transparent retry risks a duplicate job).
27	
28	**Ask First:** None — docs/input is silent on poll cadence and the period-picker widget; both decided in Design Notes per AGENTS.md policy.
29	
30	**Never:**
31	- Wire the real download (`GET /export/:jobId/download`) or make "Baixar PDF"/"Baixar dados brutos" tap-functional — Story 7.2.
32	- Give `data_ready` its own visual/download-enabled treatment — Story 7.2; render identically to "Processando" here.
33	- Add empty-period UX polish beyond `export-screen-states.md`'s table — Story 7.3.
34	- Persist jobs locally (no Hive box) — ephemeral, polled live (AD-15).
35	
36	## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix
37	
38	| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output | Error Handling |
39	|----------|--------------|------------------|-----------------|
40	| Create job | Confirm period | `jobId` stored, sheet opens Pendente | Create fails → inline error, sheet never opens |
41	| Pendente | `status=pending` | Spinner, "Preparando exportação..." | N/A |
42	| Processando | `status=processing\|data_ready` | Progress bar, "Gerando resumo com IA..." | N/A |
43	| Concluído | `status=done`, `narrativeStatus=done` | "Resumo pronto", PDF+raw buttons shown (disabled; 7.2 wires taps) | N/A |
44	| Narrativa falhou/pulada | `status=done`, `narrativeStatus in {failed,skipped}` | Only raw button; copy scoped to narrative | N/A |
45	| Erro | `status=error`, other `errorCode` | Generic error copy, no download | Non-retryable, terminal |
46	| Período vazio | `errorCode=EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` | "Nenhum registro nesse período." + adjust-period suggestion | Maps to `Failure.exportEmptyPeriod` |
47	
48	</frozen-after-approval>

52	- `lib/features/export/{data,domain,presentation}/` -- empty scaffold; target for all files below
53	- `lib/core/network/{api_client,url_builder,retry_interceptor}.dart` -- call via `get/post(function, {pathParams})`; `neverRetriedFunctions:36-40` add `'export-summary-create'`
54	- `lib/core/failure/failure.dart:30-31,67-83` -- `exportEmptyPeriod` already defined/wired; reuse only
55	- `lib/features/chat/domain/entities/bookmark_state.dart` -- sealed-base `const factory` pattern to mirror
56	- `lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart:44-46` -- `registerFactory<TextEntryCubit>` one-shot-cubit precedent
57	- `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart:93-97` -- add `registerExportFeature()` after chat
58	- `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_filter_sheet.dart:70-114,160-169` -- sheet choreography + shell to mirror (`radiusLg`/`elevation2`/`colorScrimHeavy`/`durationSheetUp`)
59	- `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart:202` + `lib/core/widgets/back_arrow_header.dart` -- header call site/widget; add optional `trailing` param (default null)
60	- `lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart` -- `primary`/`secondaryOutline`/`textGhost` for PDF/raw/"Fechar"
61	- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1417-1550` + `docs/input/backend/export-screen-states.md` -- schemas + authoritative status×narrativeStatus×downloadAvailable table
62	- `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md:95-104` -- exact PT-BR copy per state
63	
64	## Tasks & Acceptance
65	
66	**Execution:**
67	- [x] `lib/core/design_tokens.dart`, `back_arrow_header.dart` (`trailing` param) -- visual plumbing
68	- [x] `lib/features/export/domain/{entities/export_job_state.dart,repositories/export_repository.dart}` -- sealed `preparing`/`generating`/`done(outcome)`/`error(Failure)`/`emptyPeriod`; `createJob(...) -> Either<Failure,String>`, `getStatus(jobId) -> Either<Failure,ExportJobState>`
69	- [x] `lib/features/export/data/{models/export_job_status_dto.dart(+.g.dart),datasources/export_remote_data_source.dart,repositories/export_repository_impl.dart}` -- DTO + calls to the two functions + thin repository pass-through (no cache); DTO→state mapping per the status table
70	- [x] `lib/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit.dart` -- `Cubit<ExportJobState>`; `start()` creates job then `Timer.periodic` (2s) polls to a terminal state; cancels in `close()`
71	- [x] `lib/features/export/presentation/widgets/export_status_sheet.dart` -- static `.show(context, {cubit})` mirroring filter-sheet choreography; `BlocBuilder` swaps body per state
72	- [x] `lib/features/export/export_injection.dart` + `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- `registerExportFeature()` (singleton data source + repository, `registerFactory<ExportJobCubit>`), wired in
73	- [x] `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart` -- download icon in header trailing slot; `onTap` → `showDateRangePicker` → `start()` → `ExportStatusSheet.show()`
74	- [x] `lib/core/network/retry_interceptor.dart` -- add `'export-summary-create'` to `neverRetriedFunctions`
75	- [x] Unit tests: `ExportJobCubit` transitions (I/O matrix rows), `ExportRemoteDataSource` DTO→state mapping incl. empty period
76	
77	**Acceptance Criteria:**
78	- Given I tap the download icon and select a period, when I confirm, then the job is created and the export sheet opens (`radiusLg`/`elevation2`).
79	- Given the job is in progress, when polled, then the sheet reflects the five named states, `status`/`narrativeStatus` independent.
80	- Given a stage changes, when the sheet updates, then content replaces in place — never closes/reopens mid-job.

83	
84	- [x] [Review][Patch] "Fechar" dismiss link bypasses the shared `AppButton`/`textGhost` variant the Code Map names for it — bare `GestureDetector`+`Text`, no minimum tap target, present in all 5 sheet states. [export_status_sheet.dart:103](../../lib/features/export/presentation/widgets/export_status_sheet.dart#L103) — fixed: now `AppButton(variant: textGhost)`.
85	- [x] [Review][Patch] 6 export files fail `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` (verified) — run the formatter before merge. [export_job_status_dto.dart](../../lib/features/export/data/models/export_job_status_dto.dart), [export_job_state.dart](../../lib/features/export/domain/entities/export_job_state.dart), and 4 test files under `test/features/export/` — fixed: formatter run, verified clean.
86	- [x] [Review][Patch] Export feature is never resolved through the real `get_it` graph in `bootstrap_integration_test.dart` — every other feature has a dedicated block catching broken registrations before real app launch; export has none. [bootstrap_integration_test.dart](../../test/core/di/bootstrap_integration_test.dart) — fixed: added a mirroring test block.
87	- [x] [Review][Patch] pt_BR locale config (`main.dart`) has no test observing it — the one behavior it was added for (localizing `showDateRangePicker`) is unverified; existing widget tests use a bare `MaterialApp` with no locale configured. [main.dart:161](../../lib/main.dart#L161) — fixed: new `_pumpScreenWithLocale` test asserting the picker's own pt_BR "Salvar" label.
88	- [x] [Review][Patch] `_pollInFlight` overlap guard has no test that produces an actual overlap — every fake `getStatus` resolves instantly, so the stale-response race this guard exists to prevent is never exercised. [export_job_cubit.dart:89](../../lib/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit.dart#L89) — fixed: new `fakeAsync` test with a gated `getStatus` call spanning two ticks.
89	- [x] [Review][Patch] `_exportInFlight` double-tap guard has no test — unlike the sibling `_navigatingToDetail` guard in the same file, which has exactly this kind of double-tap test. [meus_registros_screen.dart:197](../../lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart#L197) — fixed: mirrored the sibling double-tap test.
90	- [x] [Review][Patch] `export_job_cubit_test.dart` drives every scenario against the real 2s `Timer.periodic` with real wall-clock delays (confirmed ~48s for this file alone) — use `fake_async` or an injectable clock for determinism and speed. [export_job_cubit_test.dart](../../test/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit_test.dart) — fixed: whole suite rewritten on `fake_async`, now ~2s.
91	- [x] [Review][Patch] No `Semantics(liveRegion: true)` (or equivalent) announces export sheet state changes — a screen-reader user gets no signal when the job's state advances. [export_status_sheet.dart:93](../../lib/features/export/presentation/widgets/export_status_sheet.dart#L93) — fixed: wrapped per-state content in `Semantics(liveRegion: true)`.
92	- [x] [Review][Defer] Create-call `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` would surface as a generic `SnackBar`, not the dedicated "Nenhum registro..." copy, if ever returned synchronously [meus_registros_screen.dart:196](../../lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart#L196) — deferred, pre-existing (already recorded in `deferred-work.md` by this same commit)
93	- [x] [Review][Defer] `status: done` + `narrativeStatus` ∈ {pending, processing} collapses into "narrative failed," a combination absent from the authoritative table [export_job_status_dto.dart:61](../../lib/features/export/data/models/export_job_status_dto.dart#L61) — deferred, pre-existing (already recorded in `deferred-work.md` by this same commit)

Undocumented discrepancy, unlike the `data_ready` hybrid state which `epic-7-context.md` does flag. [prototype-extract.md:101](../../docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md#L101) — deferred, pre-existing

[export_status_sheet.dart:58](../../lib/features/export/presentation/widgets/export_status_sheet.dart#L58) — deferred, pre-existing

101	- Poll: fixed 2s `Timer.periodic`, no client timeout (docs/input silent; server job always reaches a terminal state).

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `lib/core/design_tokens.dart`, `back_arrow_header.dart` (`trailing` param) -- visual plumbing
- [x] `lib/features/export/domain/{entities/export_job_state.dart,repositories/export_repository.dart}` -- sealed `preparing`/`generating`/`done(outcome)`/`error(Failure)`/`emptyPeriod`; `createJob(...) -> Either<Failure,String>`, `getStatus(jobId) -> Either<Failure,ExportJobState>`

- [x] `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart` -- download icon in header trailing slot; `onTap` → `showDateRangePicker` → `start()` → `ExportStatusSheet.show()`
- [x] `lib/core/network/retry_interceptor.dart` -- add `'export-summary-create'` to `neverRetriedFunctions`
- [x] Unit tests: `ExportJobCubit` transitions (I/O matrix rows), `ExportRemoteDataSource` DTO→state mapping incl. empty period

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given I tap the download icon and select a period, when I confirm, then the job is created and the export sheet opens (`radiusLg`/`elevation2`).
- Given the job is in progress, when polled, then the sheet reflects the five named states, `status`/`narrativeStatus` independent.
- Given a stage changes, when the sheet updates, then content replaces in place — never closes/reopens mid-job.

## Spec Change Log

## Design Notes

- Poll: fixed 2s `Timer.periodic`, no client timeout (docs/input silent; server job always reaches a terminal state).
- Period picker: Flutter's built-in `showDateRangePicker` (docs/input silent; free-form dates, unlike the 3 fixed `DateRangePreset` filter presets).
- `data_ready` folds into `generating`'s visual here (no case of its own) — same copy/no-download, since lighting it up is 7.2's job.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- generates the DTO's `.g.dart`, no conflicts
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- all pass, incl. new cubit/data-source tests

## Suggested Review Order

**Job state model (entry point)**

- The two independent axes (`status`/`narrativeStatus`) collapsed into one sealed state, mirroring `BookmarkState` rather than `Resource<T>` (AD-12).
  [`export_job_state.dart:15`](../../lib/features/export/domain/entities/export_job_state.dart#L15)

- The authoritative status table implemented once, with `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` detected by `Failure` subtype rather than a second string check (AD-3).
  [`export_job_status_dto.dart:51`](../../lib/features/export/data/models/export_job_status_dto.dart#L51)

**Polling lifecycle & resilience (review patches)**

- `start()` creates the job then kicks off the poll loop; a create failure emits the terminal error state instead of ever polling.
  [`export_job_cubit.dart:60`](../../lib/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit.dart#L60)

- `_pollInFlight` stops a slow `getStatus` call from racing a newer tick and un-terminating an already-finished job.
  [`export_job_cubit.dart:89`](../../lib/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit.dart#L89)

- A persistent (not transient) poll failure now gives up after 5 consecutive misses, reusing the existing Erro state rather than polling forever.
  [`export_job_cubit.dart:109`](../../lib/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit.dart#L109)

**Export request correctness (review patches)**

- `periodEnd` is bumped to local end-of-day before the UTC conversion, so the last day picked is no longer silently excluded.
  [`export_remote_data_source.dart:33`](../../lib/features/export/data/datasources/export_remote_data_source.dart#L33)

- `export-summary-create` added to the never-retry set — a transparent retry on this non-idempotent POST risked a duplicate job.
  [`retry_interceptor.dart:45`](../../lib/core/network/retry_interceptor.dart#L45)

**Entry point & sheet UI**

- Download icon → period picker → job creation → sheet, with an in-flight guard against a double-tap racing a second job.
  [`meus_registros_screen.dart:196`](../../lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart#L196)

- `BackArrowHeader` gains an optional trailing slot (default `null`) so the other two screens using it are unaffected.
  [`back_arrow_header.dart:13`](../../lib/core/widgets/back_arrow_header.dart#L13)

- One `BlocBuilder` swaps the sheet's body per state; `_doneContent` is where Concluído and Narrativa-falhou diverge.
  [`export_status_sheet.dart:127`](../../lib/features/export/presentation/widgets/export_status_sheet.dart#L127)

**PT-BR localization (review patch)**

- `showDateRangePicker` was rendering in English with no app-wide locale configured; now pinned to `pt_BR`.
  [`main.dart:161`](../../lib/main.dart#L161)

**Peripherals**

  [`export_injection.dart:16`](../../lib/features/export/export_injection.dart#L16)

- Widget tests for the sheet's 5-state rendering and the cubit's poll-cap/overlap fixes (review patches: these didn't exist before this round).

12	/// overlay (`cerne-prototype.html`), its 5 states (Pendente/Processando/
13	/// Concluído/Narrativa falhou/Período vazio) swapped in place by one
14	/// `BlocBuilder` over [cubit]'s own [ExportJobState] — the sheet itself
15	/// never closes/reopens mid-job (Boundaries); every state keeps "Fechar"
16	/// at the bottom (UX-DR15).
17	///
18	/// Mirrors `EntriesFilterSheet.show()`'s own choreography
19	/// (`isScrollControlled`, `useSafeArea`, `colorScrimHeavy`, a
20	/// Reduce-Motion-aware `durationSheetUp` entrance/exit) — Code Map.
21	/// [cubit] is a fresh, `get_it`-factory-scoped instance the caller has
22	/// already started (`ExportJobCubit.start()`) before ever showing this
23	/// sheet (Boundaries: "Create fails → inline error, sheet never opens") —
24	/// closed here, once the sheet is gone, mirroring `InsertionModal.
25	/// show()`'s own cubit-disposal convention; the caller never has to
26	/// remember to do this itself.
27	class ExportStatusSheet extends StatelessWidget {
28	  const ExportStatusSheet({required this.cubit, super.key});
29	
30	  final ExportJobCubit cubit;
31	
32	  static Future<void> show(
33	    BuildContext context, {
34	    required ExportJobCubit cubit,
35	  }) async {
36	    final reduceMotion = MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations;
37	    final controller =
38	        BottomSheet.createAnimationController(Navigator.of(context))
39	          ..duration = reduceMotion
40	              ? Duration.zero
41	              : DesignTokens.durationSheetUp
42	          ..reverseDuration = reduceMotion ? Duration.zero : null;
43	    try {
44	      await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
45	        context: context,
46	        isScrollControlled: true,
47	        useSafeArea: true,
48	        barrierColor: DesignTokens.colorScrimHeavy,
49	        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
50	        elevation: 0,
51	        transitionAnimationController: controller,
52	        builder: (_) => ExportStatusSheet(cubit: cubit),
53	      );
54	    } finally {
55	      // Same "wait for the exit animation before disposing the
56	      // controller" rationale as `EntriesFilterSheet.show()`'s own
57	      // `finally` block.
58	      if (!controller.isDismissed) {
59	        final animationDone = Completer<void>();
60	        void onStatusChange(AnimationStatus status) {
61	          if (status == AnimationStatus.dismissed) {
62	            animationDone.complete();
63	          }
64	        }
65	
66	        controller.addStatusListener(onStatusChange);
67	        await animationDone.future;
68	        controller.removeStatusListener(onStatusChange);
69	      }
70	      controller.dispose();
71	      // The one-shot factory cubit's own disposal — mirrors
72	      // `InsertionModal.show()`'s own `await cubit.close()` convention;
73	      // cancels `ExportJobCubit`'s internal poll `Timer` too (its own
74	      // `close()` override).
75	      await cubit.close();
76	    }
77	  }
78

81	    return Container(
82	      width: double.infinity,
83	      padding: DesignTokens.exportSheetPadding,

88	        ),

94	          bloc: cubit,
95	          builder: (context, state) {
96	            return Column(
97	              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
98	              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
99	              children: [
100	                // Review finding (blind-hunter layer) — `liveRegion: true`
101	                // so a screen reader announces each poll-driven stage
102	                // change (Pendente → Processando → Concluído/Erro) instead
103	                // of staying silent until the user manually re-explores
104	                // the sheet.
105	                Semantics(
106	                  liveRegion: true,
107	                  child: Column(
108	                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
109	                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
110	                    children: _contentFor(state),
111	                  ),
112	                ),
113	                const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingXs),
114	                AppButton(
115	                  label: 'Fechar',
116	                  variant: AppButtonVariant.textGhost,
117	                  textColor: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary,
118	                  onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
119	                ),
120	              ],
121	            );
122	          },

# Test Automation Summary

## Scope

Flutter/Dart project — "E2E" here means the project's own established
convention of `*_flow_e2e_test.dart` files: the real DI graph (`sl`),
real `Cubit` -> `Repository` -> `DataSource` -> `ApiClient` -> `Dio`
pipeline (both real interceptors attached), with only the transport
boundary (`HttpClientAdapter`) and native plugins faked (no
device/simulator/CI exists yet per AGENTS.md). Playwright/browser E2E
does not apply to this codebase.

Target feature: **export** (story 7.1 — request a period export & job
status tracking), chosen because capture, entries, and chat already had
this level of coverage; export did not.

## Generated Tests

### E2E Tests

- [x] `test/features/export/export_flow_e2e_test.dart` — 5 tests, driven
  directly against the real, DI-resolved `ExportJobCubit`:
  - Happy path: `start()` → genuine `export-summary-create` POST (URL,
    headers, periodEnd bumped to local end-of-day before UTC
    conversion) → real `Timer.periodic` poll loop → genuine
    `export-status-get/{jobId}` GETs → Pendente → Processando →
    Concluído (`ExportOutcome.narrativeReady`); also asserts polling
    really stops once terminal.
  - Narrativa falhou: `narrativeStatus: failed` maps to
    `ExportOutcome.narrativeUnavailable` through the real DTO mapping.
  - Período vazio: `errorCode: EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` maps through the
    real `Failure.fromCode` → `ExportJobState.emptyPeriod()`.
  - Erro: a non-empty-period error code (`AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT`) maps
    to the generic `ExportJobState.error`.
  - Review-patch coverage: `export-summary-create` failing with a
    *retryable* code (`RATE_LIMITED`) is never retried — proves
    `RetryInterceptor.neverRetriedFunctions`' real wiring for this
    function (previously only exercised in isolation or against a fake
    repository, never through the real Dio pipeline).

This complements, and does not duplicate, existing coverage:
`export_job_cubit_test.dart` (fake repository, I/O-matrix transitions),
`export_remote_data_source_test.dart` (mocked `ApiClient`, DTO
decoding), `export_status_sheet_test.dart` (widget rendering per
state), and `meus_registros_screen_test.dart`'s "export entry point"
group (tap → picker → `start()` → sheet, against a fake repository).
None of those drove a real network/poll round trip end to end.

### API Tests

Not applicable separately — the backend contract is exercised through
the same e2e suite above (real `ApiClient`/`Dio`/interceptors against a
faked transport), consistent with how every other feature in this
project is tested (no standalone HTTP-level test layer exists outside
this pattern).

## Verification

- `fvm flutter analyze` — 0 issues
- `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` — clean (after one auto-format
  pass)
- `fvm flutter test` — **1100/1100 passed**, no regressions in the
  existing suite

## Coverage

- Features with `*_flow_e2e_test.dart` coverage: capture, entries,
  chat, **export** (new)
- Still missing this level of coverage: auth, account, vault (epic 8 —
  dashboard/profile/logout/account-deletion — is still `backlog`, so
  N/A for now)

## Next Steps

- Consider the same real-pipeline e2e treatment for auth (login/refresh/
  expired-session recovery) and vault (biometric/PIN gate) when their
  own review cycles come up.
- Story 7.2 (independent raw-data download) will need its own e2e
  additions once the download taps are wired for real — this suite's
  "done" tests intentionally only assert the disabled-button state that
  exists today.
